The exact recurrence F(v,S), evaluated over all 32 five-bit starts, has maximal 21 edges, hence word length 26. An independently coded exhaustive memoized recurrence of 6,824 states recovered exactly 22 maximizing linear words, partitioned into six reversal/complement orbits of sizes 2,4,4,4,4,4. Every maximum begins with 00000 and ends 11111 or the complement arrangement, 11 in each orientation. The source supplies a second independent literal-string search and a full 22-word list. Finite classification is exhaustive by the state recurrence, not an extrapolation.
